sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.artist, r.text as ruling_text, c.hasContentWarning, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes - has missing or degraded properties' ELSE 'No missing or degraded properties' END as content_status FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Jim Pavelec' ORDER BY c.name, r.date
